description: This file defines the ComplexOperations class, which provides static methods for performing arithmetic operations (division, subtraction, sum, product) on complex numbers in text format. It is part of the PhpSpreadsheet library's calculation engine for engineering functions.

classes.name: ComplexOperations
classes.description: A class providing static methods for complex number arithmetic operations such as division, subtraction, sum, and product, supporting array inputs and integration with Excel-like error handling.

methods.name: IMDIV
methods.description: Performs division of two complex numbers, with support for array inputs and error handling.

methods.name: IMSUB
methods.description: Performs subtraction of two complex numbers, with support for array inputs and error handling.

methods.name: IMSUM
methods.description: Calculates the sum of multiple complex numbers, supporting array inputs.

methods.name: IMPRODUCT
methods.description: Calculates the product of multiple complex numbers, supporting array inputs.
